text: Good afternoon, Captain. I'm Diego Martínez, the new deck cadet.
Ah, the cadet! Come in, sit down. Welcome on board.
Thank you, sir. The bosun said I sign on with you this afternoon.
say: Thank you, sir. The bo'sun said I sign on with you this afternoon.

text: That's right. Is this your first ship?
Yes, it's my first ship.
Everybody has a first ship. OK, this is the crew agreement. Your passport and your seaman's book, please.
Here you are.
So, you're joining as deck cadet. Your surname… how do you spell it?
Mike, Alfa, Romeo, Tango, India, November, Echo, Zulu. Martínez.
With a Z. Good. Nationality, Argentine. Date of birth… the twelfth of August, two thousand and four.
Sorry, Captain. Two thousand and three.
note: Stress on THREE: he is correcting the Captain.

text: Three. You're right, I need new glasses. Now, your seaman's book number. Read it to me, please.
Alfa Romeo, zero, four, seven, nine, two, six.
AR zero four seven nine two six. Good. Sign here, please.
Here?
Yes, next to your name. Right, you're signed on. The Chief Officer will meet you in your cabin later, for your safety kit.
